hourly_automation_rule: Update market JSON only; never rewrite UI files or VERSION.
root_entry: public/index.html redirects to the permanent online live entry
v038_issue: Current theme section could show only the evaluation card and a large blank area while real theme cards were missing.
v038_root_cause: full-recovery-v22 still reads legacy localStorage cache mr:last-good:v025 before fresh network data.
v0.3.7 cache cleanup did not validate/remove an incomplete last-good object.
A stale partial cached object can therefore leave themes/top_picks incomplete when fresh refresh is delayed or fails.
v038_fix: cache-guard-v38.js validates legacy cache before full-recovery and removes it unless market exists, themes>=4 and top_picks>=5.
integrity-v38.js compares window.__MR_D.themes with actual #themes theme cards and rebuilds missing cards.
Theme fold-body height/min-height/overflow are normalized so blank clipped regions cannot remain.
stable-v038 does not reach 100% until the theme-card count matches the current data count.
MutationObserver rechecks the theme section after later optional scripts mutate the DOM.

screenshot_build_mark.location: fixed at the extreme top-left of stable-v038.html
screenshot_build_mark.purpose: Low-contrast micro text for identifying the exact UI build from user screenshots.
screenshot_build_mark.rule: Increment with every UI version, e.g. v0.3.9 -> MR039.

performance_rules: Compounder TradingView charts remain lazy-loaded only after unfold and viewport approach.
1Y/2Y/3Y/5Y returns come from one compounder-returns.json request, not 76 browser-side Yahoo requests.
Core rendering and optional analytics remain separated.
Theme integrity checks add no external data requests.
android_back_contract: Open detail/modal -> hardware Back closes it.
must_preserve: all current theme cards under the theme evaluation
compounders grouped by theme/rank with weekly charts and 1Y/2Y/3Y/5Y returns
real load percent + progress bar + exact failure stage
qa: stable-v038.html displays v0.3.8 and contains MR038.
Actual theme card count equals window.__MR_D.themes.length before core success.
The theme evaluation card is followed by visible real theme cards, not a blank area.
Successful core render reaches 100.000% and the loading panel disappears.
APK v0.3.6+ follows public/app-live.html and therefore receives v0.3.8 online UI.
